description: Describes StatutoryLetters' organisational letter generator, used by charities, advice services, schools, local authorities and housing providers to draft their own formal responses and decisions against relevant legal frameworks, or to write on behalf of the people they support. Each letter is generated from the organisation's own declared circumstances and position, not from a shared or reused template. Letters are framed against Education Act 1996 and SEND, Children and Families Act 2014, Care Act 2014, Housing Act 1996, Equality Act 2010 section 149 PSED, NHS Complaints Regulations 2009, Children Act 1989, and Human Rights Act 1998. Priced at the organisation tier. Use this when the person asking is an organisation sending the letter, rather than an individual complaining to one.
